name: Nitro Blaze

specialAbility.name: Turbo Boost
specialAbility.description: Nitro Blaze fires up its rear exhaust and rockets forward at double speed, smashing everything in its path!

lore: Nitro Blaze was built by a rocket scientist who thought regular monster trucks were way too slow. With twin turbo exhaust pipes that shoot real flames and a paint job that looks like its already on fire, this truck is the fastest thing on four giant wheels. Buckle up, because it has only one speed: BLAZING!
